newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen easing on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen easing on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open mixed on Thursday and may ease near the close on profit-taking before the Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said.
"The market should consolidate at this point. It has risen by 67 points in two sessions," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securites said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 38.11 points, or 2.73 percent, to end at 1,431.74 on Wednesday. There were 153 gainers and 67 losers. Turnover rose to 29.69 million shares from 22.79 million in the previous session.
